about: Unity's physics components that are Box3D's one to one, which tide unity translates (notes/unity.md, Packages' translations of Unity's components)
sourceAbout: Added to a Unity project's game: a body starts where its entity's Transform (Unity's placement) is, and the Transform follows the body
source: // A body whose entity has Tide's Transform (in Unity, every one): it starts where the Transform places it, whatever
// its position said, and the Transform follows it after each step, so Unity shows the body where it is. A body's
// place is the world's: one under an entity that turns isn't turned with it.
system StartAtTransform(mut Body body, Transform transform)
system FollowTransform(Body body, mut Transform transform)
